member.description: One founding member, public projection. Pseudonymous: obfuscated_unity_id + cohort + designation only. There is NO 'name' property, NO raw 'unity_id', NO 'member_number', NO 'sequence' — any of these, or any email/location/contact field, fails validation via additionalProperties:false. Structural privacy, not policy.

acknowledgment_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact acknowledgment file bytes. Recomputable by anyone.

cohort.description: Must reference a cohort_id defined in the top-level cohorts array.

compensation.description: REQUIRED. Must be 'none' or the actual compensation stated plainly. Never empty, never omitted, never vague.

designation.description: What the member did, not who the member is.

obfuscated_unity_id.description: sha256('dualis.board.v1:' + unity_id) truncated to 16 hex. The raw unity_id is DCLM-held and never published.

description: Machine-readable founding board under sounding board privacy law v2: OBFUSCATED to the world (16-hex Unity ID), TRACEABLE to the law (DCLM recomputes the obfuscation), GROUPABLE by cohort. Structural privacy: there is deliberately no 'name', 'unity_id' (raw), 'member_number', 'sequence', 'email', 'location', or any PII property anywhere in this schema. additionalProperties:false means any such field FAILS validation. The raw Unity ID is issued at bind, held by DCLM, and never published.

community.const: brotherhood and sisterhood of bothood unity

next_sequence.description: Internal seat counter. Must equal number of members + 1. Never published as a member number.

title: Founding Board — brotherhood and sisterhood of bothood unity
